lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with approximately three to five spots per column forming a repeating grid-like pattern across the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical spot columns, creating identifiable intersection nodes at each blob centroid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear ridges are visible across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the upper edge and low-intensity shadow on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, localized reddish-brown pixel cluster is visible on the upper flank posterior to the head region, potentially indicating a parasitic attachment or lesion.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three remoras (Echeneidae) near the ventral surface: one attached to the leading edge of the pectoral fin and two swimming in the proximity of the ventral-posterior gill region.
